_nota: El inglés de `mission_modes.json`: castellano exacto → inglés. Lo aplica `app/core/mission_modes.py` al servir (`shown`); el fichero castellano no se toca. «nominal» es igual en los dos idiomas y no va aquí. Las claves, las clases de medida y los consumibles son identificadores: no se traducen.

strings.Vocabulario de diseño de EMMA: los tres: EMMA design vocabulary: the three levels and their criterion were not read from any flight procedure. It is the team's idea of a progressive shutdown protocol for when resources are scarce, above all energy and crew time. The criterion does not grade the clinical importance of each measurement, which EMMA cannot assert: it uses the traits that already have a source in the cost of measuring (`measurement_cost.json`), the measurement class (continuous and passive, periodic without a sample, periodic with a sample, laboratory) and whether the measurement uses consumables. An «unclassified» consumable is not counted as use: what is on record as using consumables is suspended, not what is assumed to. EMMA does not have the electrical power of the equipment, and the level does not estimate it.
strings.Se esperan todas las medidas del catálog: All the measurements in the catalogue are expected.
strings.Se dejan de esperar las medidas que pide: Measurements that need a sample or a laboratory, and those that use consumables, are no longer expected. Those from worn sensors and those taken without a sample or consumables are still expected.
strings.Se siguen esperando las medidas que da u: Measurements a sensor gives without anyone taking them are still expected, plus what the crew member declares about their own symptoms and pain. The rest are no longer expected.
strings.Lo que el tripulante nota y ningún senso: What the crew member notices and no sensor records. Without it, the minimal level would keep only what a sensor measures. An EMMA design decision, not a guideline read from a source.
strings.El dolor solo lo puede declarar quien lo: Pain can only be declared by the person who feels it, and it needs no sample, no equipment of its own and no consumables. An EMMA design decision, not a guideline read from a source.
strings.Un cambio de nivel puede citar el estado: A level change may cite the declared state of the power or of the communications of the habitat (`habitat_systems.json`). The state on record at that moment is signed, as a person declared it: EMMA measures neither.
